C0724.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Hallucination in Large Language Models
C0724.summary: A 50-page survey by researchers from Harbin Institute of Technology and Huawei systematically examines the multifaceted challenge of hallucination in LLMs, highlighting its persistent impact on model reliability, especially in domains requiring factual accuracy.

references.title: A Comprehensive Review of LLM Hallucinations: Harbin Institute of Technology Team Releases 50-Page Survey
